description: Apply rules 3 to 5 of Pick a direction and the Recent picks check: calm words narrow to quiet, editorial, or sharp families; the history blocks recent directions, heroes, and effects; the group check blocks two-of-three matches; the name number breaks the tie. You judge which directions fit the subject (rules 1, 2, 4) and pass them as `fitting`.

calm.description: They used a calm word: clean, simple, professional, plain, calm, quiet, corporate, serious, trustworthy

fitting.description: Direction ids whose mood names this subject's world

history.description: Recent pick lines, for a client that keeps its own history. The local server reads ~/.design-lounge/history.jsonl

product.description: Product or brand name, for the name number. Without one, the first noun of their message
